verdict.rationale: Official SDKs are a fair question for a package manager, since it could ship client libraries for programmatic integration. The evidence documents only the CLI and a JSON listing endpoint (formulae.brew.sh/docs/api), and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. None of the evidence shows an official SDK in any language. A raw JSON API is a developer building block, not an SDK, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
